description.en: The strangest objects in the universe — where gravity wins completely, light cannot escape, and even time behaves in ways that defy imagination.
description.hr: Najcudniji objekti u svemiru — gdje gravitacija potpuno pobjedjuje, svjetlost ne moze pobjeci, a cak se i vrijeme ponasa na nacine koji prkose masti.

back.en: A region where gravity is so strong that nothing — not even light — can escape once it crosses the edge.
back.hr: Podrucje gdje je gravitacija toliko jaka da nista — ni svjetlost — ne moze pobjeci jednom kad predje rub.

back.en: The 'point of no return' around a black hole. Cross it and nothing can bring you back — not even light.
back.hr: 'Tacka bez povratka' oko crne rupe. Predji je i nista te ne moze vratiti — cak ni svjetlost.

back.en: Most form when a very massive star runs out of fuel and collapses under its own gravity in a supernova.
back.hr: Vecina nastaje kad vrlo masivnoj zvijezdi ponestane goriva i urusi se pod vlastitom gravitacijom u supernovi.

front.en: Can we actually see a black hole?
front.hr: Mozemo li stvarno vidjeti crnu rupu?

back.en: Not directly — but in 2019 scientists imaged the glowing ring of gas around one, the first 'photo' of a black hole's shadow.
back.hr: Ne direktno — ali 2019. naucnici su snimili uzareni prsten plina oko jedne, prvu 'fotografiju' sjene crne rupe.

media.image_hint: Event Horizon Telescope snimak crne rupe u M87 (2019). Trazi 'black hole M87 EHT' — izvor je EHT/NSF, provjeri uslove koristenja (obicno slobodno uz navodjenje). Alternativa: NASA ilustracija crne rupe.

back.en: A giant black hole millions to billions of times the Sun's mass, sitting at the heart of most galaxies — including ours.
back.hr: Divovska crna rupa miliona do milijardi puta masivnija od Sunca, u srcu vecine galaksija — ukljucujuci nasu.

front.en: What sits at the center of our galaxy?
front.hr: Sta se nalazi u sredistu nase galaksije?

back.en: Sagittarius A*, a supermassive black hole about 4 million times the mass of the Sun, 26,000 light-years away.
back.hr: Strijelac A*, supermasivna crna rupa oko 4 miliona puta masivnija od Sunca, 26.000 svjetlosnih godina daleko.

front.en: What would happen if you fell into a black hole?
front.hr: Sta bi se desilo da upadnes u crnu rupu?

back.en: Gravity would stretch you into a long thin stream — nicknamed 'spaghettification'. Not a pleasant way to go.
back.hr: Gravitacija bi te rastegla u dugu tanku nit — u sali zvano 'spagetifikacija'. Ne bas ugodan kraj.

front.en: Do black holes really bend time?
front.hr: Da li crne rupe stvarno savijaju vrijeme?

back.en: Yes. Near one, time runs slower relative to far away. Close to the edge, an hour for you could be years for someone distant.
back.hr: Da. Blizu jedne, vrijeme tece sporije nego daleko. Blizu ruba, tvoj sat mogao bi biti godine za nekog udaljenog.

back.en: The heart of a black hole, where matter is crushed to an infinitely dense point and known physics breaks down.
back.hr: Srce crne rupe, gdje je materija zdrobljena u beskonacno gustu tacku i poznata fizika prestaje vaziti.

back.en: Probably not. Stephen Hawking showed they slowly leak energy and could evaporate over unimaginably long timescales.
back.hr: Vjerovatno ne. Stephen Hawking je pokazao da polako gube energiju i mogle bi ispariti kroz nezamislivo duge periode.

explanation.en: This slow leak is called Hawking radiation.
explanation.hr: To sporo curenje zove se Hawkingovo zracenje.

front.en: Could a black hole ever swallow the Earth?
front.hr: Bi li crna rupa ikad mogla progutati Zemlju?

back.en: There are none close enough to threaten us. The nearest known is over 1,500 light-years away — utterly harmless to Earth.
back.hr: Nijedna nije dovoljno blizu da nam prijeti. Najbliza poznata je preko 1.500 svjetlosnih godina daleko — potpuno bezopasna za Zemlju.

front.en: How small can a black hole be?
front.hr: Koliko mala crna rupa moze biti?

back.en: A stellar black hole can pack several Suns into a region just kilometers across — a whole star squeezed into the size of a city.
back.hr: Zvjezdana crna rupa moze sabiti nekoliko Sunaca u podrucje siroko svega nekoliko kilometara — cijela zvijezda stisnuta na velicinu grada.
